title: Reading Drill — Testing a leaflet about river access — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a leaflet about river access — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The river access officer in Millcross received an old report about people following a path shown as open when its gate is closed. The report compared outdated route reports, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the visitor messages rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered five weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include unusual rainfall. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed a seasonal route note as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
